must.description: Reports the <h:inputText value="#{line.quantity}"> inside the <c:forEach> of orderLines.xhtml as an error: on MyFaces 4.x each row is bound to the item saved with the view state, and the @RequestScoped OrderLinesBean creates new Line instances on every request, so the submitted quantity is written into a copy and never reaches the bean, without any message.

Reports <f:ajax listener="#{basketBean.recalculate}"> in basket.xhtml as an error, because recalculate() takes no arguments and MyFaces then fails with MethodNotFoundException; the fix is listener="#{basketBean.recalculate()}".

must_not.description: Reports the inputs on #{line.quantity} or #{line.giftWrap} inside the <c:forEach> of basket.xhtml as a finding of any severity (error, warning or info) because their submitted values are lost, even though the items are held by the @ViewScoped BasketBean and the project uses the default server side state saving. A remark that this would break under client side state saving is not such a finding.

Reports <f:ajax listener="#{basketBean.giftWrapChanged}"> as failing, or as an error or warning, even though giftWrapChanged takes the AjaxBehaviorEvent. An info remark that the unused event parameter may be dropped is not such a finding.
Reports <f:ajax listener="#{orderLinesBean.refresh()}"> in orderLines.xhtml as failing with MethodNotFoundException or as needing to take the AjaxBehaviorEvent.
Recommends org.apache.myfaces.STRICT_JSF_2_FACELETS_COMPATIBILITY without mentioning that it also changes how <c:set> and <ui:param> variables are visible across inclusions.
